content.comment_body: Hello, is it possible to create a momentary button within [product_name] Web Editor?
No, this needs to be handled in the [product_name] software itself.
I've attached some possible solutions for you to consider.
You can address the issue by modifying the software that isn't working as intended. However, I've tried this method but didn't achieve the desired result.

Hello [user_name], English is the official language in the international [company_name] forum. Please make sure your future posts are in English, since not everyone here understands Spanish. If you need help, translators like Google Translate can be useful. Can you clarify exactly what is not working with my earlier suggestions? Please upload your [product_name] Web Editor project and the associated [product_name] program as a ZIP archive so we can review where it’s failing for you.

Hi, sorry, I’ve responded in English now. Your proposed solution works well—I tested it and it functions properly. However, another forum informed me that the issue of a switch appearing instead of a button may be because of the program I installed. When I tap the button on my phone, it behaves as a switch rather than a momentary button. I was told that there is a version or driver that can resolve this, but updating and reinstalling the program didn’t help. Maybe you have further advice?
I’m not sure if I can assist, as I’m unclear about your description. What exactly do you mean by "Verdion"? How is this related to your phone?

Let me clarify: I’m using the latest version of [product_name] and have a monitoring program that allows controlling the automation via mobile, tablet, or computer. My issue is that when I press a button to activate an input, it functions like a switch, but I need it to work as a push button. I’m unsure how to adjust this behavior.
All relevant information has already been covered in this topic. Are you experiencing any difficulties with my solution?

If you require a momentary impulse for switching, you must store that impulse. When the V-bit is set to a '1' signal for the first time, a cycle pulse is triggered in the [product_name] program, which activates the pulse relay. If the V-bit is set to '1' again, another pulse toggles the relay off, resulting in the output Q1 being switched. If this isn’t happening in your setup, then your program may not match the example screenshot I provided. Please share your program so I can review any differences. Edit: The user [user_name] has removed their post.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are trying to achieve push-button input behavior through the [product_name] Web Editor for mobile and tablet access to automation systems. The main obstacle is that Web Editor inputs function as toggling switches rather than momentary buttons, creating confusion and unsuccessful attempts to correct this via software updates or configuration changes. Users rely heavily on forum discussions due to unclear documentation and limited built-in software features.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a straightforward ability to set up momentary (push-button) inputs in the [product_name] Web Editor so it works seamlessly across devices, with the software offering clear and dependable push-button functionality.
